This reed is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in sea coasts and saltwater shores, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

This reed yields a decoction prized for complex fractures, especially when a bone has shattered into several pieces. Once administered, the affected limb must remain completely motionless for eight hours. Prolonged constipation is a known side effect, and repeated treatment carries a risk of habituation despite its remarkable results.
